A.name: Ground-truth provenance
details: The executed AW path uses full_records -> official_records/source_records -> RGBNT100._process_dir, retaining dataset filename identity/camera for query/gallery. Identity labels are parsed from names, cameras are reduced by one, and scene is -1. The dataset provider contains an inherited Market1501 docstring; the actual RGBNT100 directory/parser and artifacts, not that docstring, establish this route.

AW installed_context asserts installed train/query/gallery equality to its stored manifest and identity-disjoint train/test. AW discards the identity label during model forward; labels enter only post-forward metrics and cohort diagnostics. Native/cache equality is explicitly consistency, never replacement identity GT.

This audit independently decoded all eight metadata arrays in each of the four NPZ containers, checked original AV/AW equality and filename-derived IDs/cameras/scenes, and checked all 30 CSV metadata tables plus all spatial record labels. It did not access the remote installed image tree or freshly recount train identity disjointness.

B.name: Score normalization
details: AP is mean precision at relevant ranks; INP is relevant count divided by last relevant rank; Rank-k and CMC are query averages after same-ID/same-camera exclusion. Reported percentages multiply by 100. There is no metric division by the model own maximum, minimum or mean. All 30 raw matrices were independently stably sorted and all AP/INP/rank fields matched exported rows.

F.normalize in extraction/unit-direction outlets changes feature coordinates before squared-Euclidean distance; it does not normalize reported accuracy by prediction statistics. Pool512, relation3584 and final5120 outlets remain named and dimension-labelled.

Attention probabilities are conditioned within input-source spatial blocks; entropy/log(N), exp(entropy)/N, lift=N*max_probability and JS are descriptive attention statistics. Their normalization is not a retrieval performance denominator or foreground label.

C.name: Result existence, numerical agreement and provenance
details: All 120 primary files exist, were read and SHA256/size inventoried; the same hashes were rechecked at report completion. All 30 per-query CSVs (51,450 rows), corresponding stage JSONs, all six metrics, CMC1-50, camera/scene/identity groups, 36 comparisons, labelled error cohorts and CPU summary tables agree with independent local arithmetic.

The raw recount covered every row of every one of the 30 AW distance matrices (441,183,750 finite values). Maximum per-query AP discrepancy is 4.440892098500626e-16 and INP discrepancy is zero. Both AW normal11 distance payloads are byte-exact with the corresponding original AV caches. This equality does not count as two additional independent raw ranking recounts.

All 20,580 spatial rows and 5,659,500 numeric cells are present, correctly labelled and finite. All 11,000 role summary scalars agree within the documented eight-significant-digit CSV rounding bound. The 84 original F processing summary rows and 84 supplemental reading-scale means were independently recomputed.

Four child launch/exit/log/result records are mutually consistent and exit0. Both native64 gates finished before either full launch. Native receipts support 128 hooked plus 128 plain record executions; full receipts support 20,580 official record executions. Current controller snapshot equals the terminal intake copy.

All 83 text intake manifest entries match current primary bytes/SHA. Both D: AW raw archives and both D: original AV reference arrays match recorded bytes/SHA. Cleanup receipt records seven matching remote duplicates, 2,813,809,784 bytes, protected bests exact and zero unique best deletion. Source restricts that cleanup to two AW raw duplicates, four restored inputs and its own package. No remote state was queried by this audit.

Original R1 recorded native70746 exit1 before NN; its diagnostic records cwd /home/gaob, unresolved evaluator and absent AW root. R2 explicitly inserts the project import directory and has a real CPU-import PASS with CUDA uninitialized and model count0. R2 reused the four restored inputs; source/receipt maps report zero neural-source changes and zero recopy. R1 failure remains intact.
Producer fields preserved_pending_local_transfer=true and controller local_transfer_completed=false are pre-intake snapshots; later verified complete_intake provides the transfer/closure record.

D.name: Actual called metrics and unchanged-output pipeline
details: The actual child commands invoke evaluate_r201aw_AV_frequency_outlets.py with smoke/full modes, not the older AG, AR or AT command-line entrypoints. The AW STAGES loop calls distance, full_metrics, independent recount/verify and changes, and writes all 30 measured stage artifacts. The result values are independently established by raw recount, not by function existence or a preflight PASS.

AT AttentionAudit dynamically overrides the AR expert prehook through self.expert registration. Its active implementation uses sequence-first _in_projection_packed, preserves aliased initial cross-band Q=K=V arithmetic, and normalizes only M projected Q per head by L2*sqrt(8), matching the listed AS forward. F and cross Q remain unnormalized. Every saved M effective-query norm is 8 and each saved F effective/projected-query norm pair is equal.

Hooked forward captures actual projection/calibrator inputs/outputs, and observation hooks return None. Extraction is no_grad/eval; native source restores conditions/removes hooks before the plain replay. Result receipts assert exact same-batch hooked/plain outputs, exact cached query/gallery outputs and unchanged state versions, frozen anchor and input digests. Local byte comparison independently proves full normal distance equality; AW feature tensors are not stored, so local AW feature equality cannot be freshly tensor-compared.

Auxiliary pools are reconstructed from FP32 per-relation unit projections and trained bias-free softmax scores, using M weighted*7 then mean and F weighted sum. They are separately labelled reconstructed diagnostic outlet features, not an extra deployed forward. The complete inherited scorer/fuser ancestry is outside the primary source list, so this audit does not claim a new independent neural re-execution of that ancestry.

Source-only R1/R2 reviews are used for hash binding and historical gating, not treated as runtime acceptance. Full_evaluation main/docstring concerns a different dev-selected CLI; AW imports its metric/distance helpers and uses the explicitly benchmark-selected AV checkpoints.

E.name: Experimental scope and claim ceiling
details: Actual scope is one dataset (RGBNT100), full normal query1715/gallery8575, two fixed controls at seed42, selected epochs axis20 and ordinary frequency6. There are 15 observed outlets per fixed checkpoint, not 30 independently trained models or 30 independent trials. Native64 is a gate with no AP claim. AW itself has zero optimizer updates and zero new weights; no missing-modality,49-condition,new-seed or RGBNT201 evaluation occurred in this task.

The original RGBNT100 teacher result records 50 epochs, seed42, selected epoch8, 6357 updates and benchmark-mAP/earliest-tie checkpoint selection. AV source declares the same frozen teacher seed42 plus fresh expert/head initialization and an additional 50-epoch stage, with AW checking 6563 AV updates. This is an inherited teacher-plus-extra-stage budget, not a fresh single 50-epoch standalone budget. The selected AV epoch histories and checkpoint bytes are outside the primary list; only guarded source, hash-bound receipts and saved reference arrays are freshly audited here.

Both original teacher and AV checkpoints use official query/gallery mAP for selection. These numbers are benchmark-selected single-seed evidence, not an untouched independent final test or robustness across seeds.

The unchanged axis normal11 mAP/Rank-1 are 86.1546433016181 / 96.7930029154519, versus base00 85.76856710316947 / 96.61807580174927. Recomputed gains are 0.3860761984486345 mAP and 0.1749271137026227 Rank-1 percentage points. This diagnostic supplies no new model accuracy and does not establish a +1-point goal.

Residual standalone retrieval, attention/variance/reading scales and GT-selected rescue unions cannot establish additive fusion value, foreground importance, causal failure mechanism, a deployable oracle, improvement from Q amplification, novelty, or training/inference performance. Recorded producer seconds include diagnostics/metric/export work and are not a fair latency comparison.

F.name: Evaluation type classification
details: All 30 homogeneous query/gallery outlet retrieval measurements are real_gt: identity/camera metadata comes from dataset names, with official same-ID/same-camera exclusion. normal11 is the unchanged deployed descriptor; base00 is the inherited frozen identity descriptor; the other 13 stages are GT-evaluated internal feature diagnostics with different dimensions.

Native hooked/plain/cache parity and full normal11 cache equality are consistency-only checks against model-produced references. They are not label-ground-truth accuracy measures and are not presented as such.

The 275 attention/value/reading fields are feature/attention diagnostics without foreground GT. Query cohort stratification uses real labels offline. Teacher head-mean probabilities, per-head statistics, source-conditioned spatial measures and cross-band statistics remain distinct conventions.

F_source processing fields are measured before source embedding/ordinary mixing. In axis_shared, F slots correspond to physical sources; in ordinary frequency_shared, each query slot reads all source blocks and is not a source-specific expert. These are learned patch-feature bands, not raw sensor spectral truth.

The six-selected-MF oracle and thirteen-internal-outlet union use known GT on fixed error cohorts after inference. They are offline oracle coverage diagnostics, not deployment selectors, new model scores or independent rescues/causes. The supplemental F Q/K/V table is another saved-reading-scale diagnostic only.
